visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young East Asian man with short dark hair, wearing a dark blue long-sleeved sweater, stands in a brightly lit indoor studio. He smiles at the camera and points his right index finger toward a large black smartwatch on his left wrist. The background features a large window with a blurred urban skyline of high-rise buildings and construction. (2) A close-up shot focuses on the Apple Watch Ultra 3. The device has a rugged matte black casing and a dark fabric loop band. The digital screen displays a complex compass watch face with white and pink markings. The lighting is sharp and professional, highlighting the watch's texture and metallic buttons. (3) The man holds the watch against a light gray surface, demonstrating different screen faces. One face shows a portrait of a woman, while another features a colorful Snoopy animation. A split-screen comparison graphic appears, labeling the current model as 'Apple Watch Ultra 3' and comparing it to the 'Ultra 2'. (4) Close-up macro shots show the man's fingers interacting with the watch's screen and digital crown. He scrolls through a colorful honeycomb-style app menu. Later, a shot reveals the watch displaying a list of options including 'Alarm', 'Fall Detection', and 'SOS Emergency Call' on a gray interface. (5) The man returns to a medium shot in the studio, gesturing with both hands as he speaks. Large white and yellow text overlays appear to show the price. He looks down at the watch on his wrist and then back at the camera, ending with a satisfied expression.
